app.name: Stash
app.tagline: Know what you have at home

auth.linkSent: Check your inbox — we sent you a sign-in link.
auth.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Stash needs a connection for this page. Nothing is lost — try again once you are back online.

inventory.empty: Nothing in stock yet. Add what you have at home, place by place.
inventory.noPlaces: This household has no storage places yet. Add one first.
inventory.countHelp: Each one becomes its own item, so they can expire separately.
inventory.countRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.
inventory.expiresAtHelp: Optional. Applies to all of them — you can change a single one later.
inventory.alreadyClosed: Someone else already checked this off.
inventory.cannotUndo: This can no longer be undone: its storage place was deleted.
inventory.deleteHelp: Only for mistakes. To record that it was used up or thrown away, check it off instead.
inventory.refreshFailed: The list could not be refreshed. What you see may be out of date.

offlineVoorraad.queued: Checked off — it will be sent once you are back online.
offlineVoorraad.notSent: Some check-offs could not be sent ({count}).
offlineVoorraad.alreadySent: This check-off was already sent and can no longer be undone here.
offlineVoorraad.undoUnconfirmed: Undo couldn't be confirmed. Check your inventory again later.
offlineVoorraad.signOutBody: Check-offs not sent yet: {count}. They will be lost if you sign out now.

products.gtinCheckDigit: That barcode's check digit does not add up. Saving it anyway is fine.
products.contentHelp: Without content and unit this product drops out of price comparison.
products.contentUnitTogether: Fill in both content and unit, or leave both empty.
products.lastName: A product keeps at least one name. Add another language first.
